messages:
sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — proposal: replace the dockerized hello-world quickstart with a tiny serverless function example (Vercel / Cloud Run) and switch auth to a short-lived token flow. Aims: lower local setup friction and shorten the path to a first deploy. Looking for quick reviews on compatibility + screenshots.

ryan: +1. Do we keep parity with SDK v5 surface? We'll need Node and Python snippets. Also think about a tiny curl example for CI smoke runs.

olivia: Removing Docker means the Deploy step images change. I can take new screenshots on mac later today (macOS Ventura). Any preferences for viewport? I usually do 1280x720.

gabe: Heads up — lint is failing on a fenced code block in the PR. CI output snippet:
```text
Error: md-lint: fenced-code-block indentation at docs/quickstart/serverless.md:45
```

ci-bot: linkcheck failed: 2 broken links (third-party examples). Full CI: https://ci.redwood/pulls/482/logs

sara: pushed a quick fix for the fenced-code-block indentation and added a Node serverless snippet using the short-lived key pattern: 
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk';

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_SHORT_KEY });
  const out = await client.generate({ prompt: 'Hello world' });
  res.json({ text: out });
}
```

ryan: Nice. Can you add the Python equivalent + a minimal curl example? I can run a smoke test on Cloud Run once those are in.

olivia: Also need a short copy update for the "Auth model" sidebar — we currently reference long-lived keys. Recommend: "short-lived tokens (rotate every 24h)" + a migration note for enterprises.

sara: Good call. I'll update the sidebar and add a migration note called "From long-lived keys to short-lived tokens". Quick task list: @olivia screenshots, @ryan smoke test, @gabe check CI nits. Target to merge by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Preview site deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference/pull/482 — review the page under /quickstart/serverless

ryan: LGTM pending CI green and my smoke test. I'll give final approval after I validate Cloud Run.

gabe: tiny nit — env var should be REDWOOD_SHORT_KEY (not REDWOOD_SHORTKEY). Fixed in a follow-up commit.

sara: Thanks all — waiting on CI + smoke test then I'll merge. :rocket:
